card.name: Semen, sperm and donation wording
card.fires_on: Words in or just before text about semen, sperm retrieval and donation, such as the 'en' in Semen, 'donate' after 'men should not', and linking words before IVF or apheresis products.

modes.label: Inside the word Semen
modes.description: The 'en' ending of Semen in headings about semen donation or semen characteristics.
modes.example: 5.13 Sem<<en>> Donation Based on animal data, men should

modes.label: Donating semen
modes.description: The word donate after 'men should not', just before semen.
modes.example: Based on animal data, men should not<< donate>> semen during therapy and for 90

modes.label: Linking words before fertility or collection products
modes.description: Small words such as for, in, of or and that come before in vitro fertilisation, spermatogenesis in men, or an apheresis product.
modes.example: the sperm may be able to be extracted from your testes and then used<< for>> in vitro fertilisation (IVF)

card.writes: It seems to promote words like frozen and freeze, which fit stored or frozen sperm and cells.
card.plain: It lights up in text about semen, sperm and donation, where freezing or storage may come next.
